diff.content:
diff --git a/lineage/parse.py b/lineage/parse.py
--- a/lineage/parse.py
+++ b/lineage/parse.py
@@ -8,17 +8,14 @@ CANONICAL_LINK = "link_type"
 def parent_links(entry):
     """Return the parent links declared by one dependency entry.
 
-    Historically the exporter emitted the link kind under several names.
+    The exporter now emits exactly one canonical field, so only that field is
+    read. The former aliases are gone from the export contract and reading them
+    would keep accepting shapes the exporter can no longer produce.
     """
     links = []
     for item in entry.get("dependencies") or []:
         if isinstance(item, str):
             links.append(item)
             continue
-        kind = (
-            item.get(CANONICAL_LINK)
-            or item.get("relation")
-            or item.get("linkType")
-            or item.get("type")
-        )
+        kind = item.get(CANONICAL_LINK)
         if kind == "parent_child":
             links.append(item["issue"]["id"])
     return links
diff --git a/tests/test_parse.py b/tests/test_parse.py
--- a/tests/test_parse.py
+++ b/tests/test_parse.py
@@ -10,6 +10,18 @@ def test_parent_links_reads_a_string_entry():
     assert parent_links({"dependencies": ["p-1"]}) == ["p-1"]
+
+
+def test_parent_links_reads_the_canonical_link_field():
+    entry = {"dependencies": [{"link_type": "parent_child", "issue": {"id": "p-2"}}]}
+    assert parent_links(entry) == ["p-2"]
+
+
+def test_parent_links_ignores_a_retired_alias():
+    entry = {"dependencies": [{"type": "parent_child", "issue": {"id": "p-3"}}]}
+    assert parent_links(entry) == []

change_contract.goal: Narrow the dependency-entry parser to the one canonical link field the exporter now emits, dropping the retired aliases.
acceptance_criteria: The canonical link field is read.
A retired alias is not read, so a shape the exporter can no longer produce is not silently accepted.
A bare string entry keeps working.
non_goals: Keep a compatibility path for retired aliases.
preserved_behaviors: A bare string dependency entry resolves exactly as before.

repository_instructions.label: Export contract rules
repository_instructions.summary: When the export contract narrows, the reader narrows with it in the same change. Keeping a reader for a retired shape hides exporter regressions instead of surfacing them.

data: `lineage/export.py` emits only `link_type`; the aliases were removed from the export contract in the same release.
No stored data is replayed through this parser: every entry it sees comes from a live export.
operational: The exporter and this parser ship together and are always the same version.
